_note: One file per action scene: scenes/<sc>/action-plan.json. Beats follow anticipation -> execution -> contact -> reaction -> recovery (skip what the beat does not need). positions are screen sides against the 180-degree axis; an actor changes side only with axis_cross {reason}. props start in actors[].props (prop -> hand) and change through state_after ("<actor>.<prop>": hand, or "dropped"). visibility: show | imply (cut around the contact) | hybrid. A shot's event_frame is 0-based inside the shot; fx names a preset from impact-fx-presets.json. Validate with `anime-studio.py validate-action <scene>`; `plan-action` writes proposals, never edl.json. An original fight: characters and moves are this series' own.

beats.intent: Mira plants her feet and raises the pipe; the Warden's visor locks on

shots.framing: low medium close-up, over Mira's shoulder

beats.intent: she lunges across the yard, pipe swinging from her right
the pipe meets the Warden's chest plate (hand contact is morph-prone, so cut around it)

sfx: heavy metal clang on armour, close

shots.framing: extreme close-up on the chest plate

beats.intent: the Warden staggers back two steps, a dent glowing on its chest; Mira's pipe is bent
Mira exhales, re-grips the bent pipe; the Warden rises
